Now, I move that the following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of the public meeting. Whereas the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provision of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act.

And whereas Section 2.2-3712 D of the Code of Virginia requires certification by this committee of the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law, now therefore be it resolved that the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that to the best of each member's knowledge, one, only public business
